meta.name: Golden Axe
meta.description: Legendary warriors Ax Battler, Tyris Flare, and Gilius Thunderhead reunite to save Yuria from the evil giant Death Adder, who just won't seem to stay dead. Their quest is complicated by Hampton Squib, an inexperienced and wildly underprepared adventurer whose dream of heroism far exceeds his abilities. Forced to work together despite their flaws, they must find a way to stop Death Adder once and for all.

videos.title: The Legend of the Emerald Blade
videos.overview: Gilius Thunderhead leaves his questmates in search of the Emerald Blade.

videos.title: Rideable Beasts
videos.overview: Gilius and Hampton seek a Rideable Beast. Chronos embarrasses Ax and Tyris.

videos.title: Tender Hamlet
videos.overview: Gilius and Hampton visit a town where the villagers are suspiciously nice.

videos.title: Fly Like an Eagle
videos.overview: Gilius, Hampton, Ax, and Tyris fight the Bad Brothers aboard a giant eagle.

videos.title: The Brothers Bad
videos.overview: Hampton is taken prisoner. Ax, Tyris, and Chronos go on a side quest.

videos.title: Return to Wenisburg
videos.overview: Gilius and Hampton visit Hampton's hometown. Ax and Tyris go to the library.

videos.title: The Cold Bard Truth
videos.overview: A bard leaves Gilius out of his songs. Janzu must face his family.

videos.title: Into the Cowoods
videos.overview: Gilius and Hampton overcome their fears to escape a magical forest.

videos.title: Because We're Us
videos.overview: Gilius, Hampton, Ax, Tyris, Chronos, and Druda arrive at Death Adder's castle.

videos.title: For Yuria
videos.overview: In the season finale, Gilius realizes he cannot take on Death Adder alone.
